record.text:
It's not humanly possible to biff the shot of a World Series final out celebration worse than this FOX broadcast.

It made it seem like the Brewers just won free nuggets

LNN: Nuggets calm the waves a bit with a wire-to-wire win as Nikola Jokic gets his 200th career triple-double. 

Lots of good from this game.
Nikola Jokic recorded his 200th career triple-double in the Nuggets' win over the Pelicans. He joins Russell Westbrook in NBA history. via The Denver Post

Denver Nuggets 104, New Orleans Pelicans 91.
Herbert Jones – 19 minutes, 4 points (1-4 2pg, 0-1 3pg, 2-2 FT), 2 rebounds, 2 steals, 1 block, 1 turnover, 1 foul, +2.
Soooo long. That sequence harkened to 2024-2025. #Nuggets

Portland, dangerous but flawed; Minnesota very good, but they have Gobert; Nuggets very good, but flawed; Mavs very good but imperfect; Suns too...

West is super deep; but less impossible than the last couple of years.

If they can make a trade SOON, then they can stay healthier...
ate some chicken nuggets with ranch life is gooodd
